tasks.label: Compilar C/C++
args: $ext = "${fileExtname}"; $pasta = "${fileDirname}"; $output = Join-Path $pasta "output"; if (!(Test-Path $output)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $output | Out-Null }; if ($ext -eq ".c") { $arquivos = @(Get-ChildItem $pasta -Filter "*.c" -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); if ($arquivos.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error "Nenhum arquivo .c encontrado."; exit 1 }; & "C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\gcc.exe" -fdiagnostics-color=always -g $arquivos -o (Join-Path $output "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } elseif ($ext -eq ".cpp") { $arquivos = @(Get-ChildItem $pasta -Filter "*.cpp" -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); if ($arquivos.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error "Nenhum arquivo .cpp encontrado."; exit 1 }; & "C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\g++.exe" -fdiagnostics-color=always -g $arquivos -o (Join-Path $output "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } else { Write-Error "Abra um arquivo .c ou .cpp antes de compilar."; exit 1 }
